purpose: Represent authored top-down 2.5D platforms without continuous height painting.

storage.separationRule: structural authoring never rewrites raw geological or hydrology height
storage.pcgDefaultRange: 0..=2 unless a world-generation profile explicitly requests higher authored structures

boundaryResolution.visuals: Shared ElizaWy structural recipe projects discrete Level 1 through Level 4 faces with identical straight/diagonal/terminal receiver-row counts for a given tier delta.
boundaryResolution.runtimeWhileProviderQuarantined: retired; ElizaWy structural provider is active, with fail-open fallback only when the source texture cannot load

connectors.placementRule: explicit attachment with visual, collision, traversal, footprint, and provider metadata

runtimeSemantics.ramp: south-facing one-level edge where both adjacent semantic tiles are MountainPath; runtime opens the face and shows the ordinary path corridor rather than the rejected partial diagonal sample
runtimeSemantics.stairs: reviewed south-facing higher host only: ObjectKind::Stairs on the structural edge; one-level by default
runtimeSemantics.ladder: reviewed south-facing higher host only: ObjectKind::Stairs with object state ladder, or a Stairs connector spanning a multi-level edge
runtimeSemantics.bridge: TileKind::Bridge on either side of a structural edge; existing bridge renderer owns artwork
runtimeSemantics.cave opening: ObjectKind::CaveEntrance at an eligible south-facing cliff host; interaction/transition owns entry and the face remains collision-blocking
runtimeSemantics.waterfall socket: RiverWater structural drop into a lower water neighbor on a supported south/west/east edge; traversal remains blocked

connectors.ladderAuthoringNote: N5R reuses the existing Stairs attachment with ladder state so runtime/editor schemas do not fork; a dedicated editor-facing Ladder row can be added later without changing traversal authority.

acceptance: Create Level 1 and Level 2 plateaus spanning storage partitions and verify boundary collision matches visible cliff edges.
Verify geological height values do not change during structural edits.
Verify one-level MountainPath pairs open a ramp lane and other unconnected level edges block.
Verify Stairs and ladder-state Stairs open exact structural connector lanes.
Verify CaveEntrance uses interaction/transition rather than walking through the cliff face.
Verify Bridge tiles open crossing edges and waterfalls stay blocked while animating.
Temporarily remove the certified cliff source and verify structural collision fails open rather than creating invisible walls.
Author and serialize Level 3 and Level 4 platforms without clamping them to Level 2.
Verify editor bridge and runtime shared cliff recipe project exactly 1, 2, 3, and 4 receiver rows for matching south-facing tier deltas.
